Q: Did you pick up any damage from the contact with George? "Not that I'm aware of. I don't think it did anything. But I mean the car, more or less, felt the same it did all weekend so...yeah. A difficult one. At least we could keep George behind after the stops but um just a tricky weekend."

Q: What are the takeaways from this weekend, it's unusual for you to struggle to this extent. "I think as a team we've both struggled a pretty big extent but yeah definitely for me, the pace has been pretty bad. Plenty to try and understand. And see what we can do better." https://t.co/I0uyzguOw3

Q: Just talk me through how the race unfolded from your perspective "It was very tough, for sure. We were able to keep Russell behind at least which was good. But yeah it was pretty, pretty challenging. Just to get lap time out of the car which has been the same all weekend." https://t.co/Tc4qbuzkAB

Q: When you say tricky, can you pick out for us what exactly you're wrestling with? Still the issues in slow speed or a lack of predictability about what the car is gonna do? "A bit of both. I mean the car is just very very difficult to extract the performance from. I think if you can do it, it's reasonably quick but trying to do it is...as I said yesterday, very very tough. We're continuing to work on it and hopefully we can get there soon."
Q: For these fans, what do you want to say? "Just a massive thank you! Nice, nice to be back, always amazing racing here in Austin so excited to try and put on a good show!" https://t.co/mY8xWMrZM2

Q: Has there been a sector or a section that's been challenging to master? "Um...all of them this weekend! But no I mean they're very different sectors here. Obviously sector 1 is very very fast, sector 3 very tight and where we are now is very very tough and technical part of the track so it's a bit different everywhere. But its been challenging in every sector this weekend!"

Q: If this race becomes a battle for strategy rather than pure pace, how aggressive are you willing to be with the tyre life and pitstop timing? "I think from where I'm starting, we've not got too much to lose. So we'll see how the first lap goes and the start goes but yeah. It's gonna be an unknown for everybody. I think whether it's a one stop, two stop. Whether you're on a soft, medium, hard. We're in a reasonable position to take some risk from that side of things."
